title: [Windows 11] Open Dialog and close will crash the Godot Engine (D3D12)
body:
### Tested versions


- Reproducible in: v4.6.2.stable.official.71f334935, v4.7.beta1.official.1c8cc9e7e, v4.6.2.stable.custom_build.001aa128b,  v4.6.stable.official.89cea1439
- Not reproducible in: v4.5.2.stable.official

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot Engine v4.6.2.stable.custom_build.001aa128b - D3D12 12_0 (Forward+) -  NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 - NVIDIA-SMI 596.21 - Driver Version: 596.21 - CUDA Version: 13.2

### Steps to reproduce

Open Godot Engine and create a blank new Project, than open any Dialog (eg. create a new Node, or open Project Setting) and close, the Godot Engine will crash. I have tried some versions after v4.6 (and build my own version locally) it all crashed, only v4.5.2.stable.official.6ce3de25a didn't (I see console log, seems v4.5.2 use Vulkan 1.4.329 nicht D3D12 just like other crashed version)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

any Project will crash after a Dialog open and close
